page.content:
Volunteer editor in the Wikipedia community.

How Wikipedian connects

  • Topic: Wikipedia — Wikipedians are the volunteer editors who write the encyclopedia.
  • Item: Talk page — Wikipedians negotiate article text on talk pages.

What is Wikipedian?

Wikipedians write, revert, and argue under user names. The community, not the Foundation staff, still makes most content decisions.

Key threads lead to Wikipedia and Talk page.
